name: STOP
meaning: Come to a complete stop and proceed only when it is safe.

name: Give Way
meaning: Give priority as required before joining or crossing traffic.

name: No entry
meaning: Do not enter from this direction.
memory_tip: Red circle with white bar = no entry.

name: Maximum speed 30
meaning: The maximum speed shown is 30 mph where the sign applies.
memory_tip: Red ring plus number = maximum speed.

name: National speed limit
meaning: The national speed limit applies subject to road and vehicle rules.
memory_tip: White circle with black diagonal stripe.

name: No waiting
meaning: Waiting restrictions apply as shown by the sign and nearby plates.

name: No stopping
meaning: Stopping restrictions apply where the sign is in force.
memory_tip: Crossed restriction is stronger than waiting-only.

name: Turn left
meaning: Traffic must follow the indicated direction.

name: Warning sign
meaning: Warns of a hazard or road condition ahead.

name: Motorway
meaning: Indicates motorway regulations or route information.
memory_tip: Blue motorway signs indicate motorway information.

name: Children
meaning: Warns that children may be crossing or nearby.
memory_tip: Slow down and scan both sides.

name: Roundabout
meaning: Follow the indicated circulation around the roundabout.
